title: Chapter 239 Business Partner
content:
Chapter 239 Business Partner

If all the strategic materials in the system store are purchased, I wonder if it will be helpful in the future attack on Nanshan Market?

He walked in and took a look. After a careful browse, he couldn't help but feel a little disappointed.

The barracks, kerosene, horse cards and other materials inside have been taken off the shelves.

Only food and some daily necessities are left, and the prices are very expensive, which makes Wang Shuo's idea of taking advantage of the loopholes fall through.

As a last resort, Wang Shuo thought of the merchants teleported from other places as mentioned by Chef Zhang.

It seems that he can only find them to see if they can cooperate.

Back to Fuyue Restaurant, Wang Shuo booked a few rooms.

Find Chef Zhang, contact several merchants from other towns, and set up a banquet.

"I am Wang Shuo, the lord of Wana Village. I wonder what your friends are called?" In the box, Wang Shuo looked at the three people in front of him and introduced himself.

"I am Wang Qian from Wang's Business in Changping County."

"I am Feng Wei from Feng's Chamber of Commerce in Luohe County."

"I am Lin En from Scarborough Market."

The three introduced themselves.

These people all belong to several newly emerging chambers of commerce, and their strength is comparable to that of Li Youcai's Li Chamber of Commerce.

Moreover, they are more enterprising and enterprising. In this chaotic world, the faster they develop, the more opportunities they can seize.

"Everyone, I will get straight to the point. I have two kinds of materials here. Please take a look." Wang Shuo took out the bronze bricks and the dead spirit beads.

The three of them took the things in their hands and looked at them carefully.

"Lord Wang, I don't know how many of these bronze bricks you have here. I am very interested in them." Wang Qian of Wang's Chamber of Commerce showed an excited look on his face after seeing them.

This kind of brick is as important to the lord as weapons and armor, and the market prospects are very broad.

"I am also very interested."

The other two people saw this and hurriedly said.

Wang Shuo smiled mysteriously.

"At present, 100,000 bronze bricks can be supplied every day, and the daily supply will increase in the future."

After hearing this, the three asked, "How do you plan to sell them, Lord Wang?"

Wang Shuo thought for a while, narrowed his eyes, and said slowly, "Have you seen this kind of bricks in other villages and places?"

Several people shook their heads. They had only seen this kind of bricks on the walls of the system town. They had never seen such bricks being sold on the market. This business must be very popular.

Wang Shuo nodded with satisfaction and said with a smile, "You also know that this is a unique business at present. Those ambitious lords must be very fond of this high-grade building material."

As he said this, he stretched out an index finger.

"1 silver coin?"

Wang Shuo frowned. They were really a group of people who had never seen the world.

"1 gold coin?"

Lin En asked tentatively. He was a little unsure.

Wang Shuo nodded and said, "This is the cost price. You decide how much to sell it for."

Considering the purchasing power of most lords, Wang Shuo did not want to set the price too high. If he could not build a city wall even if he spent all his money, then the bricks would not have much value.

To build a village-sized city wall, it only needs 500,000 gold coins, which is about it. Most lords should be able to afford 50,000 energy crystals.

Even if these merchants doubled the price, it would not be a big problem. There are always some lords who have the strength.

If you don't have this strength, there is no need to struggle under the ravages of the undead army. It is the best policy to surrender to others as soon as possible.

"Aren't you interested in this dead spirit bead?" Wang Shuo was a little surprised. This thing is a life-saving item in the future!
